world.name: Shape Fixture
world.description: A company world with the shape of a real company's package (the same types, supertypes and house-rule slots) and none of its content.

values.elsewhere: The issue tracker keeps the work, the code host the code, the docs the specs
values.privacy_rule: No student or pupil personal data, ever. Business contacts by name; nobody else from outside Company A.
values.org_kinds: Company, School board, School, Higher education, Research lab or Sector body
values.line_kinds: Pilot, Partnership, Customer, Certification, Integration, Selection
